ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels across approximately 85-90% of the visible surface; high-intensity (white) pixels comprise approximately 10-15%, concentrated primarily on the upper interior of the right lobe and distal margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe is almost entirely low-intensity with sparse high-intensity mottling at the lateral tip. Right lobe features a significant contiguous high-intensity (white) region in the upper quadrant containing approximately 6-8 distinct low-intensity (black) circular spots of varying diameters.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible wide V-shaped notch; calculated interior angle is approximately 112 degrees with a bounding depth of roughly 18% of the total vertical fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations observed across the entire trailing edge; the right distal tip exhibits high-amplitude protrusions (3-5 distinct bumps) indicative of external biological encrustation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward and outward convex sweep; the trajectory tapers to acute points at the distal tips, with the right tip appearing more rounded due to pixel clusters.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white pixel clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; distinct dark circular clusters are mapped within the white pigmentation zone of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Presence of 4-5 parallel, vertically oriented light-colored linear disruptions (rake marks) crossing the dark-to-light pigment boundary on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant biological encrustations (barnacles) visible at both distal lobe tips; parallel linear rake marks on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'dalmatian' style spotting pattern localized specifically to the white patch on the right lobe.
